retraction.reason: Retracted in M21: the last general election of the monarchy, 28 August 1910, whose results were never confirmed because the revolution of 5 October overtook them. Nothing followed from it, and that is precisely its historical point — an atlas of consequences has nothing to draw from a ballot the country stopped counting. The revolution it was overtaken by is already here as republic-proclaimed-1910.
